Burger

Hire a nashville-hot truck for a festival, company party, or event from MJ's Burger Joint. Our nashville-hots handle catering from 50 guests up, fully customized. Using our nashville-hotten for catering is much more fun, enjoyable, and often cheaper than regular catering. Bring met our nashville-hot a true showstopper to your party location. It's a real eye-catcher and very photogenic ook!

The fastest food truck in the US!

Wat maakt ons uniek?

  • Traditional perfectie

    In our nashville-hot draait alles om de traditie. Our burgers zijn precies zoals ze bedoeld zijn: een flinterdunne, zachte bodem met een luchtige cornicione (rand). Deze rand krijgt in our blazing hot ovens that create those typical small char marks that add crispiness. We work exclusively with the best American base: songerijpte San Marzano-tomaten, romige fior di latte mozzarella en fresh basilicum. Je proeft our passie in elke hap!

  • Ongekende Capaciteit: De Fastest van the US

    Organiseer je een grootschalig event? No worries about hungry guests or long lines. We combine artisan quality with festival-speed en staan bekend om our hoge bakcapaciteit. Thanks to three large flat-top griddles in one food truck, we serve up to 480 burgers per hour.

  • American experience

    De nashville-hots zijn luxe afgewerkt met marmer, warme ambient lighting and typical American details that immediately set the right mood. Denk aan kleine fotolijstjes met familierecepten van nonna en subtiele decoraties die doen denken aan een knusse trattoria.

    How it works

    Step 1

    Request a quote

    Simply tell us your preferences and get a free quote.

    Step 2

    Preparation

    We prep our chicken brine 72 hours ahead — buttermilk, cayenne, and spices for maximum flavor and crunch.

    Step 3

    Setup op location

    We arrive 1.5 hours before start time on wheels to set up and make sure everything is ready to start cooking!

    Step 4

    burgers sizzling!

    Our grill crew cook fresh burgers right in front of your guests, until everyone is full and happy.

    Our benefits

    • The fastest grill crew in town!

      With 480 Nashville burgers or 600 fresh tenders per hour from a single truck, long lines are a thing of the past. Prefer a chill vibe? We can dial it down to a relaxed, social pace too.

    • Award-winning

      Nashville Food Truck of the Year 2025 and People's Choice Award Music City Eats 2024.

    • Plates full of experience

      Thousands of events and festivals under our belt — we know exactly what it takes to run a flawless operation.

    • Premium Ingredients

      We work with the best of the best among our ingredients: locally sourced chicken and house-made spice blend for that authentic Nashville hot flavor.

    • Stress-free service

      One dedicated contact person. Including all servingware and 2.5 hours of specialized staff. Transparent pricing with no setup fees.

    Ervaring

    We have experience both as public caterer at events like Pinkpop, Tomorrowland, Formula 1, but but also as corporate caterer for clients like IKEA, Bitvavo, Adidas, and Booking.com. Thanks to this experience we know we ons effortlessly to the size and theme of the event.

    Ontzorging

    Een hiring a nashville-hot is not complicated at all. We only need one standard power outletodig, geen krachtstroom of complicatede connections. We handle the rest completely for you. From logistic planning and setup to warmly welcoming your guests and a smooth flow on wheels: everything is taken care of. Afteroop we leave everything neat and clean, making sure the location is returned in perfect condition.

    Complete American experience

    We provide more than just burgers and are happy to put together a complete American catering custom together. As starters you can choose from antipasti, bruschetta, and salads, with optional house-made gelato for dessert. We also offer a full drinks service with beer, wijn, fris en een homemade lemonade bar.
